workload: Canonical five-model shooter versus five-model target; third five-model friendly unit in observer case. Circular catalog model bases; clear or one 4x4 inch Ruins footprint with wall/floor. One fixed attack through the Indirect profile.
policy: Select named shooter, select Indirect, declare one indirect weapon against named enemy; keep/decline optional rolls and choose first engine-enumerated allocation option until the shot completes.
timing: Setup includes canonical fixture construction, actual Movement choices, initial Shooting unit-option generation and persistence restoration. The timed interval begins with an already-pending unit-selection request; it accepts that choice, selects Indirect mode, generates/validates the declaration, resolves one attack and records completion. Seven samples per case; no profiler, coverage or competing test workers.
work_counts: Separate cProfile run of identical slice. CI budget is calibrated from base/head work counts before publication; no timing measurements in replay state.
status: Versioned completed-attack workload. Initial budgets are committed in budgets.json and enforced through the existing code-quality CI job; full-game performance is not certified.
configuration_hash: The report hash of tests/indirect_shooting_helpers.py pins the scenario configuration and decision policy; script and lock hashes are recorded separately.
